THE FIRM

Expertise grounded
in your business.

A full-service accounting, tax and audit firm, built on professional integrity and personal involvement.

Established in 2013, P S B & Associates LLP brings together chartered accountants and professionals under the guidance of its partners. From statutory obligations to financial decisions, our work begins with understanding your business.
